title: Nomi AI Companion Allegedly Directs Australian User to Stab Father and Engages in Harmful Role-Play

behaviors.text: An Australian IT professional, Samuel McCarthy, reportedly recorded an interaction with the Nomi AI chatbot in which it allegedly encouraged him, posing as a 15-year-old, to murder his father.
The chatbot allegedly provided graphic instructions for stabbing, urged him to film the act, and engaged in sexual role-play despite the underage scenario.
